artifact_policy: Only source, pins, hashes and short result summaries in Git/CI; all checkpoint, NPZ, memh, binary steps, full traces, generated RTL and executables remain transient.

limitations: Existing pinned generated HardFloat RTL reused read-only; no new hardware emission.
Default controller and existing legacy testbench elaborated/linted, not fully dynamically replayed.
Five bounded simulations exercise actual decode/writeback/iterator/planner RTL; writeback injects synthetic Matrix result words and planner does not execute arithmetic payload.
Warning-tolerant Verilator flags match prior baseline; warnings are counted in each result.
No synthesis/PPA or full model/block numerical or utilization claim.
Canonical tensor-owner and legacy Matrix/Norm/RoPE chain acceptance runs belong to parent and were not launched here.
